Common Questions

Frequently asked questions.

Is the property update really free?

Yes. Both the suburb market update and the personal property appraisal are free, with no obligation to sell or list your property.

Do I need to be ready to sell?

Not at all. Many homeowners simply want to stay informed about the local market. There is no pressure to take any further action.

Is this an automated valuation?

No. A personal appraisal is prepared by Paul or Mel and considers factors an automated estimate often misses, such as condition, improvements and recent comparable sales. A computer generated valuation is only provided if you specifically request one.

Which Townsville suburbs do Paul and Mel service?

Paul and Mel specialise in Mount Louisa and Kirwan while servicing greater Townsville, including surrounding suburbs.

Will my details be kept private?

Yes. Your details are used only in accordance with the applicable privacy policy and the consent you provide, and are never sold to third parties.
